description_en: Queries the details of a specific compliance package
description_zh: 查询指定的合规包详情
name: GetCompliancePack

parameters.help_en:
The compliance package ID.

For more information about how to obtain the compliance package ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/263332.html
parameters.help_zh:
合规包ID。

关于如何获取合规包ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/263332.html
parameters.name: compliance_pack_id

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the resource.

The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:` and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

You can specify up to 20 tag keys at a time
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。

一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`或者`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https:// `。

一次最多支持输入20个标签的标签键
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the resource.

The tag value can be an empty string or a string of up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:` and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

Each tag key must have a corresponding tag value. You can specify up to 20 tag values at a time
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。

标签值可以为空或输入不超过128个字符的字符串，不能以`aliyun`或者`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https:// `。

每一个标签键对应一个标签值，一次最多支持输入20个标签键对应的标签值
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The tags of the resource. This parameter is deprecated and takes no effect if it is specified.

You can add up to 20 tags
parameters.help_zh:
资源的标签。该入参已弃用，请忽略，传入不会生效。

最多支持绑定20个标签
parameters.name: tag

ConfigRuleParameters.description_en: The information about the rule parameters

ParameterName.description_en: The name of the rule parameter

ParameterValue.description_en: The value of the rule parameter

Required.description_en:
Indicates whether the parameter is required for the rule. Valid values:

true: The parameter is required.

false: The parameter is not required
Required.description_zh:
规则中参数是否必填。取值：
true：必填。
false：非必填

Description.example: 弹性IP实例可用带宽大于等于指定参数值，视为“合规”。默认值：10 MB。

ManagedRuleIdentifier.description_en: The identifier of the rule template

ResourceTypesScope.description_en: The types of resources that are evaluated by the rule. Separate multiple resource types with commas (,)
ResourceTypesScope.description_zh: 规则评估的资源类型。多个资源类型之间用半角逗号（,）分隔

RiskLevel.description_en:
The risk level of the rule. Valid values:

1: high risk.

2: medium risk.

3: low risk
RiskLevel.description_zh:
规则风险等级。取值：

1：高风险。
2：中风险。
3：低风险

CreateTimestamp.description_en: The timestamp when the compliance package was created. Unit: milliseconds

RiskLevel.description_en:
The risk level of the compliance package. Valid values:

1: high risk.

2: medium risk.

3: low risk

合规包风险等级。取值：
1：高风险。

ExcludeRegionIdsScope.description_en: The IDs of the regions from which resources are excluded. Separate multiple region IDs with commas (,)
ExcludeRegionIdsScope.description_zh: 排除的地域范围，多个地域ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔

ExcludeResourceGroupIdsScope.description_en: The compliance package is not effective for the resources in the resource groups with the specified IDs. Separate multiple resource group IDs with commas (,)
ExcludeResourceGroupIdsScope.description_zh: 合规包仅对指定资源组ID中的资源不生效。多个资源组ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔

ExcludeResourceIdsScope.description_en: The compliance package is not effective for the resources with the specified IDs. The resources are not evaluated
ExcludeResourceIdsScope.description_zh: 合规包对指定资源ID无效，即不对该资源执行评估

RegionIdsScope.description_en: The compliance package is effective only for resources in the specified regions
RegionIdsScope.description_zh: 合规包仅对指定地域ID中的资源生效

ResourceGroupIdsScope.description_en: The compliance package is effective only for the resources in the resource groups with the specified IDs
ResourceGroupIdsScope.description_zh: 合规包仅对指定资源组ID中的资源生效

ResourceIdsScope.description_en: The compliance package is effective only for resources with the specified IDs. Separate multiple resource IDs with commas (,)
ResourceIdsScope.description_zh: 规则对指定资源ID生效。多个资源ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔

TagKeyScope.description_en: The compliance package is effective only for the resources that have the specified tag key
TagKeyScope.description_zh: 合规包仅对绑定指定标签键的资源生效

TagValueScope.description_en: The compliance package is effective only for the resources that have the specified tag key-value pair
TagValueScope.description_zh: 合规包仅对绑定指定标签键值对的资源生效

Status.description_en:
The status of the compliance package. Valid values:

ACTIVE: The compliance package is active.

CREATING: The compliance package is being created
Status.description_zh:
合规包状态。取值：
ACTIVE：正常。
CREATING：创建中

TemplateContent.description_en: The template information for the compliance package. The rule list in the template does not include user-defined function rules. You can use this template to quickly create the same compliance package for other accounts or account groups
TemplateContent.description_zh: 当前合规包模板信息，模板中规则列表不包含自定义函数规则。可基于模板信息快速为其他账号或账号组创建同样的合规包
